whyProfessional.title: Why Professional Dryclean Care for Designer Kurtas?
whyProfessional.subtitle: Occasion wear is often silk, has hand work, and is only worn a few times a year — which is exactly when a home wash does the most damage. Here is why professional dryclean care makes the difference:

points.title: Dyes Do Not Run
points.desc: Rich silks and hand-dyed fabrics can bleed in water. A dryclean solvent keeps colour where it belongs.

points.title: Zari Stays Bright
points.desc: Metallic thread tarnishes and frays with detergent and agitation; a gentle dryclean cycle avoids both.

points.title: Embroidery Protected
points.desc: Beads, sequins and mirror work are checked first and finished from the reverse, never pressed flat.

points.title: Silk Keeps Its Sheen
points.desc: Silk loses lustre and water-marks easily at home. Professional handling keeps its natural sheen.

points.title: Borders & Pleats
points.desc: Borders are pressed straight and pleats set by hand so the garment drapes as it should.

points.title: Stored the Right Way
points.desc: Returned folded with tissue, ready to store until the next occasion without new creases.
